title: Screenshot-calibration labels (operator- or generator-authored ground truth)
description: Input to calibrate-thresholds.mjs: one verdict per labeled screen. `expect` is the three-class ground truth (pass = ship it, minor = cosmetic drift, fail = must block). `expectBand` optionally pins the exact comparator band for the template's verdict-pin test (synthetic corpus cases carry it; hand-labeled real pairs usually only carry `expect`).
